name: Xperia Z3 Compact

images.credit: John Karakatsanis, CC BY-SA 2.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Announced / released: 2014-10-04 (Singapore), 2014-10-13 (United States), 2014-11-12 (Japan, SO-02G variant exclusively for NTT DoCoMo)
Launch.Predecessor: Sony Xperia Z1 Compact (Global), Sony Xperia J1 Compact (Japan), Sony Xperia A2 (Japan), Sony Xperia ZL2/Z2A (Japan, Taiwan)
Launch.Successor: Sony Xperia Z5 Compact (Global), Sony Xperia A4 (Japan)

Network.Technology: D5803: GSM, 3G, HSPA+, LTE, D5833: GSM, 3G, HSPA+, LTE, TD-LTE

Body.Other: Available in black, white, orange and green, IP65/IP68 (Dust protected, Water jet protected & Waterproof), Remote Play, Magnetic charging port, Osaifu-Keitai (SO-02G variant only), NOTTV (SO-02G variant only), POBox Plus (SO-02G variant only)

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.4.4 KitKat (launch), Android 6.0.1 Marshmallow (current), Android 10 (unofficial alternative)

Display.Display: 4.6 in diagonal IPS LCD, 720x1280 px (319 PPI)

Cameras.Rear camera: Sony G Lens 20.7 MP 1/2.3" Exmor RS IMX220S back-side illuminated sensor with BIONZ™ Engine for mobile image processor and LED flash, 2160p video recording @ 30 frames/s, 1080p video recording @ 30/60 frames/s, 720p video recording @ 30/120 frames/s
